page.overview:
What is Cador?

Cador was an obscure evil dwarven god of revenge.

Knowledge and worship of him in Faerûn was very limited. There were no large temples or widespread church dedicated to him, only small shrines and a few traveling priests and paladins. His worshipers were mostly angry dwarves seeking vengeance. All dwarves who swear fealty to Cador, as clergy or laymen, were clean-shaven.

In at least one instance, an evil dwarf prayed to Cador for "undying vengeance" and was granted this by being turned into a shade.

Category:Morndinsamman Category:Evil deities
